title: review-watch shared definitions
description: Not an output on its own. Shared definitions referenced by the CLI, hook, audit and log schemas. config.json embeds its own copies.

pr.description: Canonical PR form host/<full project path>#N (GitLab numbers written without !).

pr_id.description: forgectl's opaque PR id, stable across repository renames.

instance.description: forgectl's review_requests[].instance, opaque; null on an item whose request has no instance.

duration.description: 0 or an integer and a unit (ms, s, m, h, d).

item_id.description: rw- plus 8 lowercase base32 characters (a-z, 2-7). Output always shows the full id.

labels.description: The rw-item, rw-round and pr labels as key=value strings.

base_ref.description: Untrusted: a branch name as reported by forgectl.

glob.description: A repo-id or path glob (Path matching in docs/interface.md): * and ? match within a segment, a ** segment matches zero or more whole segments. Validated at load: no empty segment, no leading slash, no . or .. segment, ** only as a whole segment, at most three * in a segment and three ** in a pattern, at most 256 characters.

failure_reason.description: review-run's failed reasons plus no_run, draft_invalid and the reasons for a round that failed before its session.

tier_reason.description: Closed list of the rule codes that set or raised the tier.

error_reason.description: Exit 20 refusal reasons plus the reasons of exit 2 and 12.

failure_code.description: A forgectl or review-watch error code, passed through.

pr_comment_error_code.description: A copy of pr-comment's error.code enum, pinned to pr-comment's version; it holds codes review-watch's own error_code does not.

policy_name.description: gatectl's policy name grammar; also valid inside the actor auto:<policy>.

risk.description: The session's claim; can only raise the tier.

next_action.description: Commands now possible on the round: accept, accept --reanchor, edit, reject, rerun, rerun --force, resume.

trigger.description: re_request: a posted item whose request is outstanding again after its latest round posted (both hosts); skip_cleared: a skipped item whose condition cleared; rerun: a human rerun.

lower_reason.description: The lower tool's reason when the failure passed one through; else null.

failure.description: Copied from review-run's failure or set by review-watch; closed codes and counts only. exit_code is the exit of the job or call when no run existed.

decision.description: The would-be decision; null when the call gave none.

state.description: What the gate call reported. shadow, off and not_applicable are stored with enforced false (and decision null for off).

warnings.description: Any warning means no action (auto_blocked_by gate_warning).

error.description: gate_error when gatectl exited 1, 2 or 12, its output could not be parsed or it is missing; no decision is recorded.

attempts.description: Calls made for this policy; a gate_error allows at most 3 calls in total per round and policy.

outcome.description: The human outcome filed once for this decision id, else null.

gate.description: A gate record: the policy, the decision id, the would-be decision, the enforced flag and what the call reported.

warnings.description: post.warnings: landed with a warning (quick_action_ran, approved_stale_head, audit_failed).

post_result.description: The stored pr-comment result. pr-comment's success result has no landed field.

reason.description: pr-comment's error.reason, checked against its refusal grammar.

post_error.description: The last pr-comment failure of this intent (Post intent and recovery in docs/interface.md).

uncertain.description: True once a result could have landed; then only posted, rejected or closed can follow.

post_intent.description: Stored by the compare-and-set that moves a round to posting. The fixed fields are revision, revision_sha256, approve and the draft id; actor, decision_ids, reanchor_to, plan_sha256 and automatic are rewritten only in the compare-and-set that takes the round's lease for a new attempt.

head_sha.description: The PR head at creation, refreshed while queued, set to anchor.head_sha when the draft is stored (and to the new head after a re-anchor).

tier.description: One stored tier: the creation tier until drafted (when an automatic action is enabled the bound tier replaces it), then the tier bound to the draft's head.

attempt.description: The number of launches of the round, except blocked launches (Run outcomes).

session_launched.description: Set when finalize first sees a run of the round with a non-null agent_id; counts the round toward max_rounds.

revision.description: The latest revision number; null before a draft exists.

escalations.description: Escalation episodes: each entry of the round into escalated, and each held creation.

launch_override.description: Stored by resume of a pre_run escalation; poll launches with --override-escalation and this actor until a run exists.

limit_exempt.description: Set by rerun --force: the round neither counts toward the daily limit nor waits for it.

not_before.description: A queued retry is not submitted before this time (retry_after_s).

last_failure.description: The failure of the last run that was retried.

round.description: One review of an item at one head sha.

vetoed_head_sha.description: The head a pre-round hook vetoed; the veto is re-asked only when the listed head differs.

item.description: One review request keyed by (pr_id, reviewer, instance). skip_reason is non-null exactly when state is skipped.

author.description: Null for kind draft (review-run's artifact); the human actor for edit and reanchor.

hook_record.description: One hook result for the round, without output text.

snapshots_deferred.description: Candidates beyond poll.max_snapshots that wait for the next cycle.

details.description: Optional; for config_invalid the key at fault (for example forgectl me).

deadline_hit.description: True when poll.deadline ended the cycle.

poll_report.description: The poll cycle's counts, each for this cycle: discovered (listed candidates in scope), new_items, skipped (items that became skipped), out_of_scope, finalized, stale, closed, started, queued (rounds left queued). With already_running true the counts are zero and started_at equals finished_at.

message.description: Sanitized one-line text; may carry a lower tool's message.

hook.description: Copied from review-run's or pr-comment's escalation envelope.

error_body.description: Only code and message are required.

meta_review_run.title: review-run meta.review_run object
meta_review_run.description: review-run's meta.review_run object as stored on the round (pinned copy of review-run's schemas/meta.json and the defs it needs, prefixed rr_). The value of the draft's meta.review_run key (the draft's meta object holds exactly that one key). Every text field is untrusted, and meta is untrusted text downstream. A consumer treats coverage.status partial, code_run.status skipped (when it expected output), head_moved true, session.sandbox other than required, session.tools_checked false and a non-zero session.tools_unexpected as reasons not to act automatically.

skill_version.description: The bundled plugin's version for the default skill, else null.

skill_checked.description: true when the skill check ran (headless); false when it did not (interactive, with the run warning skill_unchecked).

sandbox.description: The session sandbox level from settings.json.

profile.description: bundled, variant (the bundled profile without the Agent and Task denies) or custom (a configured permission_profile).

tools_checked.description: true when the init tools list was compared with the pinned set (headless run, bundled profile or its variant).

tools_unexpected.description: How many tools outside the pinned set the init list held; never their names. 0 when the tools were not checked.

session.description: The session posture, from the run's settings.json and permission-profile.json and finalize step 5.

items.description: Untrusted: a short reason, one line.

risk_reasons.description: Untrusted: the session's reasons, at most 10 one-line strings of 1 to 200 characters.

summary.description: Untrusted: the session's summary, 1 to 2000 characters.

head_at_end.description: null when the end-of-run read failed.

head_moved.description: null when the end-of-run read failed.

rr_run_id.description: rr- plus 8 lowercase base32 characters (a-z2-7); never reused.

pointer.description: Untrusted: the JSON pointer of the parent object the rule applied to; never a dropped key name.

rr_normalized_entry.description: At most 200 entries are kept, then one entry with rule truncated and pointer empty (count: the entries omitted).

reason.description: Set exactly when status is skipped.

exit_code.description: null with a signal, when skipped and when not configured.

signal.description: The terminating signal name, else null.

sandbox.description: The mode the command ran in; null when it did not run.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sanitized output; null when it did not run.

rr_code_run.description: The code-run step's summary. status failed means a non-zero exit, a signal or a timeout; timed_out and truncated are independent booleans. The output itself is stored in the run directory, not here.

reviewed.description: The session's file ids intersected with the provided entries.

skipped.description: Every provided, truncated or skipped manifest entry not reviewed; binary and empty entries are in neither list. A truncated entry is always skipped (truncated), even when the session lists it.

ignored_ids.description: How many ids the session listed that were not provided entries; they are ignored.

rr_file_id.description: A manifest file id, f plus four digits in forgectl's file order.

rr_severity_counts.description: Counted by review-run from the findings.

rr_verdict.description: The session's claim, stored as given; never used by review-run to act.

rr_skill.description: A name Claude Code accepts as a slash command (plugin:skill or a bare name).
